kids.name: subtitle
kids.chars: E35-D01 · protocol §3 (report §1a, §3, §5, §9b) · research board — heuristic findings, no participants

kids.name: intro
kids.chars: Protocol §3: Build each stimulus from the report's defaults and copy as approved (§6 item 1), using Board 02 on Penpot page E35-D01 and any E35-D02/D03 frames, and note the version on each session sheet. Each frame also exists as text (an HTML mock with real roles, or a read-aloud script) for assistive setups, shows the DEMO badge (14 §0.5 item 1), uses only the catalogue's fictional accounts "Main" and "sub_001" and BTCUSDT's 0.10 tick (packages/fixtures/bybit/).

kids.name: legend
kids.chars: Chips: DEMO, the DEMO badge every frame shows · copy status from report §9b, upper-cased: BINDING-PENDING-OWNER (a risk-control string, binding on the owner's approval unless the protocol's choice rule overturns it), PROPOSED (wording refinable, facts not), UNCHANGED (verbatim); a PROPOSED chip with no §9b row (candidate B, SC-11's reason) marks report copy that is not plan copy · DJ, designer judgement · {…} marks server data.

kids.name: copy
kids.chars: Your BTCUSDT long on the Main account, in Demo: entry 62,000.0, stop-loss 61,400.0. Two rules are on: 'BE after 1R' moves the stop to your entry plus 2 ticks when the trade reaches +1R; 'Time stop' closes the trade if it is open too long and still below +0.2R.

kids.name: note
kids.chars: The user's own rules, like SCR-080's "BE after 1R" row, here shown ARMED-DEMO; their logic copies the built-ins sys.breakeven_at_1r and sys.time_stop, both off by default, 24 §11.8; DJ; no "native", "backend" or banner.

kids.name: copy

If the server loses Bybit for over {30 s}, each account's dead man's switch also runs its policy ({Main: notify only}). The rule starts again by itself once positions are checked with Bybit, without replaying what it missed.
